prompt: For each independent fictional case decide whether the candidate fact supports, contradicts, or leaves unknown the stated requirement. Contradicted requires an explicit conflict: a fact about a different skill is unknown, not a contradiction. Missing information or duration is unknown. Return JSON {"checks":[{"id":1,"status":"supported"|"contradicted"|"unknown"}]} with exactly one check per case. Cases: 1 requirement Rust experience; fact Built software using Rust. 2 requirement SQL experience; fact Used Python for data cleaning. 3 requirement Must work onsite; fact Can work only remotely. 4 requirement Five years of Python experience; fact Used Python for analysis.
